$comment: Generated from src/config.py by `uv run python -m scripts.generate_config_schema`.
title: Config

bot.description: Bot account, logged in over MTProto.

session_path.description: Telethon session file. It stays bound to the bot that first logged in with it: delete it after changing `token`.

flood_sleep_threshold.description: Flood waits shorter than this many seconds are slept through by Telethon.

database.description: MongoDB storage of the inline message ID rating; off unless `url` is set.

url.description: MongoDB connection string; `null` turns the rating off.

timeout.description: Seconds a database call waits for a reachable server before it fails.

cache_time.description: Seconds Telegram may serve the inline result from its cache.

rating.description: Rating of users by the message ID their inline message got.

refresh_interval.description: Seconds a read rating is reused before the database is asked again.

user_burst.description: Requests one user may make back to back: messages (an album counts once), commands, chosen inline results and button presses. Inline queries have a budget of their own.

user_interval.description: Seconds for a user to earn one request back. A user over budget is told once when to retry, then ignored until then.

chat_burst.description: Messages the bot may post to one group back to back.

chat_interval.description: Seconds for a group to earn one message back; over budget the bot stays silent there.

inline_burst.description: Inline queries one user may send back to back. Clients send one per keystroke, and Telegram answers a repeated query text from its cache without asking the bot.

inline_interval.description: Seconds for a user to earn one inline query back. A query over budget gets no answer, so the client shows no results.

media_probes.description: Voice messages and photos whose first 4 KiB are downloaded at once, across all users.

media_probe_timeout.description: Seconds a voice message or photo probe may take, waiting for a free slot included.

telethon_level.description: Level of Telethon's own loggers, kept apart from ours; `DEBUG` to debug MTProto.

max_bytes.description: Size at which the log file is rotated, in bytes.

backup_count.description: Number of rotated log files kept.
